dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, serrated light-colored perimeters forming complex closed 'O' and open 'C' loops with sharp pixel-level transitions from dark exterior to high-intensity light interior borders.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid dark interstitial patches localized between the light-colored filigree; high-intensity solid clusters are concentrated at the junctions of intersecting ring segments.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: An obtuse scalene triangle formed by the centroids of the three largest distinct annuli in the central-lateral region, coupled with a curvilinear alignment of smaller ring centroids following the upper dorsal contour.
